title: 腐烂的橘子
statement: 在 m × n 网格 grid 中，0 表示空格，1 表示新鲜橘子，2 表示腐烂橘子。每过一分钟，与腐烂橘子上下左右相邻的新鲜橘子都会腐烂。求所有新鲜橘子都腐烂所需的最少分钟数；若不可能全部腐烂，返回 -1（没有新鲜橘子时返回 0）。

en.title: Rotting Oranges
en.statement: In an m × n grid, 0 is an empty cell, 1 is a fresh orange and 2 is a rotten orange. Every minute, each fresh orange that is 4-directionally adjacent (up, down, left, right) to a rotten orange becomes rotten. Find the minimum number of minutes until all fresh oranges are rotten; if this is impossible, return -1 (return 0 if there are no fresh oranges).

complexity.space: O(m·n) (BFS queue; the input grid is not counted)
complexity.notes: m and n are the grid's row and column counts. Run a multi-source BFS starting from all rotten oranges at once; the number of levels is the number of minutes. If any fresh orange remains after BFS, return -1.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is the number of rows m; then m lines, each starting with that row's length n followed by n integers (0/1/2). stdout: one integer, the minimum number of minutes or -1.

complexity.space: O(m·n)（BFS 队列；输入网格不计入）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: m、n 为网格行列数。把所有腐烂橘子同时作为起点做多源 BFS，层数即分钟数；BFS 结束后仍有新鲜橘子则返回 -1。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行行数 m；随后 m 行，每行先写该行长度 n，再写 n 个整数（0/1/2）。stdout：一个整数，所需最少分钟数或 -1。
